channel.title: Music in Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music in Africa (musicinafrica.net)

item.title: Czech Embassy, AfricaCentric Entertainment launch cultural initiative in Nairobi
item.description: The Embassy of the Czech Republic in Nairobi, in partnership with AfricaCentric Entertainment, has launched Shanga Trails, a cultural initiative designed to highlight the artistic and historical links between Czechia and Kenya.

item.title: CupidSzn named Apple Music’s latest Up Next artist in Nigeria
item.description: Apple Music has announced Nigerian singer and songwriter CupidSzn as the latest artist to be featured in its Up Next development programme in Nigeria.

item.title: Zim’s Edith WeUtonga shortlisted for 2025 Folk Album of the Year Award
item.description: UK-based Zimbabwean musician Edith WeUtonga has been shortlisted for the 2025 Folk Album of the Year Award, becoming one of nine artists recognised in the inaugural edition of the prize.

item.title: LUUKHANYO named Apple Music’s latest Up Next artist in SA
item.description: Apple Music has announced South African musician LUUKHANYO as the latest artist to feature in its Up Next development programme in the country.

item.title: Internship opportunities in media and creative fields at the MIAF
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) invites young, passionate and unemployed individuals to apply for internship opportunities offered through the Foundation’s Internship Programme, aimed at providing valuable work experience.

item.title: Listen to Babalwa M’s new album Acquiesce
item.description: South African Amapiano artist Babalwa M has released a new 10-track album titled Acquiesce, which is available for streaming and download on major digital platforms.

item.title: Open call: National Arts Council of SA local block bursary applications
item.description: The National Arts Council (NAC) of South Africa has opened applications for bursary funding for the 2026 academic year, with a closing date set for 19 December 2025.

item.title: Open call: Création Africa programme for SA, Malawi and Lesotho
item.description: Applications are now open for the second edition of Création Africa South Africa, Lesotho and Malawi, an initiative aimed at supporting and scaling cultural and creative entrepreneurs across the three countries. The programme is supported by the French Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs, the Embassy of France and the French Institute of South Africa (IFAS).

item.title: Trace Africa to be rebranded as Trace Ngoma on 18 December
item.description: Trace, in partnership with Canal+ and MultiChoice, will rebrand Trace Africa as Trace Ngoma, with the new channel scheduled to launch on 18 December 2025 at 3pm CAT on DStv Channel 326.

item.title: No African artists featured in Deezer’s 2025 global highlights
item.description: Deezer’s annual My Deezer Year 2025 report, released on 1 December, does not feature any African artists, albums or songs in its global rankings, despite the continent’s growing influence on international music charts and culture.
